captions.detailed: An elegant arc floor lamp featuring a heavy, light-gray rectangular base, a long curved metallic-grey neck, and a hemispherical black shade. The base is equipped with a black mounting bracket that houses a revolute joint, allowing the entire curved neck to pivot forward and backward. At the top end of the arc, a black bracket assembly connects the neck to the lamp shade with another revolute joint, enabling the shade to tilt independently.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated arc floor lamp with a rectangular stone-like base, a long curved tubular post, and a hemispherical lamp shade. The post should pivot on a revolute joint relative to a bracket on the base, and the shade should pivot on a second revolute joint relative to a bracket at the tip of the curved post.
captions.factory: The design starts with a base part containing a rectangular Box representing the heavy base and a bracket made from nested box and cylinder shapes. Next, the curved post is modeled as a sweep or a series of cylinder segments mimicking an arc, mounted to a lower hinge cylinder. This post is connected to the base via a revolute joint about the horizontal axis. A top bracket assembly is constructed from small box and cylinder parts at the tip of the arc, which then connects to the hemispherical shade (created using a hollowed sphere or cut cylinder) via a second revolute joint.
